name: Förster Marie Akira
original_name: フェルスター・マリー・暁空
source:
A half-Japanese, half-German born to a Japanese father and a German mother. Influenced by his father, she developed a desire to "play soccer in Japan!" and came to Japan as a sports scholarship student. She possesses the skill level of a youth national representative, but after suffering a major injury, she has become self-destructive due to his first setback. She plans to induce the school to cancel his scholarship by deliberately engaging in misconduct so that she can return to Germany. At that time, she asks Itsuki, whom she met, to "pretend to be my boyfriend".
[translated from digital setting materials]
